newsitem.title: UK: Moody's gives US dlr subfund of BIL bonds.
newsitem.headline: Moody's gives US dlr subfund of BIL bonds.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it assigned an Aaa rating to the US Dollars subfund of the BIL Bonds umbrella fund (the Fund).
The Fund is a Luxembourg open-ended investment company (SICAV), providing six subfunds. The other subfunds of BIL Bonds have been rated Aaa by Moody's since December 20, 1995.
The Fund's investment advisor, custodian, and distributor are specialized departments of Luxembourg-based Banque Internationale a Luxembourg (BIL), rated Aa3/Prime 1.

"The Aaa bond fund rating reflects the Fund advisor's focus on investment quality, including the Fund's ability to provide a high level of liquidity to meet redemption needs, as well as the advisor's and custodian's well-developed trading, audit, and compliance systems," Moody's said in a statement.

The ratings agency also cited the financial strength of the Fund's depository bank, and that the Fund's advisor is an experienced money manager with about $3.0 billion in assets of mutual funds under management.
According to its prospectus, Moody's said the SICAV aims primarily to achieve a high performance by investing in securities issued by high quality issuers.
Moody's noted that the portfolio is mainly structured on the advisor's interest rate forecast and perceptions of relative market value of different securities.

"The portfolio is managed conservatively, and consists primarily of liquid straight bonds and deposits," Moody's said in a statement. "The credit risk is low as most securities currently held in the portfolio are either issued or guaranteed by government or corporate issuers that are rated Aaa."
Moody's said the Fund wants to invest at least 50 percent of the portfolio in securities issued by the US Government which leads to concentration in that issuer.
Ancillary cash holdings are placed with BIL, the statement said. All investments are in dollars, therefore eliminating foreign exchange risk, Moody's said.
